Results.ReviewText: This grill is great. Easy to control the temperature
Results.Title: Steaks are perfectly cooked

Results.ReviewText: It does exactly what I need and has all the features and accessories I could want in my grill. If you are needing a grill that will last you a long time (with proper care of course) then its hard to go wrong with this. The accessory market is immense and youll find exactly what you need with this grill.
Results.Title: It’s the grill everyone should start with.

Results.ReviewText: The only problem I have is that the hook on the lid doesn’t catch the lip of the grill allowing me to hang the lid on the side.
Results.Title: Only one issue with my 2nd Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, would be better if they all came with a thermometer standard.
Results.Title: Five stars

Results.ReviewText: It’s a grill. Plain and simple. I wish I could have found one made of stainless steel, but kettle style 22 inch stainless are not to be found.
Results.Title: It’s a grill. Plain and simple.

Results.ReviewText: 👍🏻 Just takes time to learn how to adjust heat with top vent   Love the extra room with the 26 over the 22.  Worth it especially slow cooking ribs for a large group of people.

Results.ReviewText: The legs was too difficult to assemble- the clip kept moving instead of clipping into place and it took too much power to turn the leg to snap it into place.
Results.Title: Disappointed in assembly

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that you were surprised that the grill you purchased did not include a thermometer. We would never want to disappoint one of our Weber fans!

This model is designed without a thermometer to provide greater options to our grillers.

We want you to feel satisfied with your Weber grill and figure out why your grill is not getting hot. Please look for an email follow-up from our Care team soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: This particular grill isn't holding heat as well as I think it's supposed to. Difficult to say, because it doesn't have a thermostat which at this price point I figured it would. Perhaps you guys will come out with the best of both worlds and that's the lump charcoal version of the pellet grill!!
Results.Title: Not quite what I was expecting

Results.ReviewText: There is little that could be said that hasn’t been said a million times before.  I did have to make a warranty claim after a week and Weber CS was fantastic!  I never liked charcoal grilling in the past, not it’s my preference.
Results.Title: 100% satisfaction

Results.ReviewText: This grill is fantastic!  I have always loved Weber, they are the only grill for me.
Results.Title: EXCELLENT!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill exactly what I needed at a great price
Results.Title: Definitely purchase

Results.ReviewText: My Weber grill is everything I thought it would be. I've cooked cow, fish, chicken and pork. It is already in need of a deep cleaning.
Results.Title: Gets the job done!

Results.ReviewText: Best, simple grill ever... Easy to use, quick convenient.
Results.Title: BEST

Results.ReviewText: Had Weber Genesis Gold for over 20 years. Decided it was too big since the kids were gone. Decided to go back to old style grilling. So far love it. Lots of fun using charcoal.
Results.Title: From Gas to Charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill to replace an old Weber Kettle Grill that was over 20 years old. This is the best charcoal grill on the market.
Results.Title: Replacement Grill

Results.ReviewText: Enjoy the kettle, just the right size. It is easy to cook on.
Results.Title: Love the Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Bought this BBQ as a replacement. Love cooking with charcoal, such a different taste than a gas BBQ. Just need to experiment more on cooking with charcoal.
Results.Title: Love the taste of a good steak done over charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: This is a great size for a grill. When we grill it's rarely for more than 4 people. It 's easy to maneuver and very easy to use.
Results.Title: Great size for small gatherings

Results.ReviewText: It has been some time since I have use a Webber charcoal grill and I am in a learning process again.  I bought the Webber charcoal chimney to go with it and it is a great help in starting the coals in a faster manner.  I am looking forward to having some good meals cooked on my grill.  In the past I have really enjoyed cooking try-tips on my old grill and I am sure I will have the same results again with my new grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: It lives up to the company's reputation. Great heat. However, I don't understand why any Weber charcoal grill comes without a holder for the lid. The inconvenience interferes with the pleasure in grilling.
Results.Title: Great Heat, But ....

Results.ReviewText: I’m a long time Weber user. I have my Kettle and my gas grill. Love it
Results.Title: Great product, have always enjoyed my Webers!

Results.ReviewText: My father owned a Weber kettle that was as old as me! Proud to be continuing on with my own!
Results.Title: Ole Reliable!

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Kettle for 19 years and recently purchased a new one.  The new Kettle is made with thinner metal and I don't like the screw on handle.  It is already loose after one use and it comes with a plastic ratchet that doesn't tighten very much.  I guess they don't want you to overtighten and chip the enamel but this is going to mean a constant loose handle.
Results.Title: I liked my old Kettle better.

Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent grill.  Easy to assemble and move around.  Nice even draw and great heat retention.  Only it had a thermometer on the lid and it would be perfect. I have owned a Genesis gas grill for 4 years so this is my second Weber.  I wanted a charcoal grill which reminds me of my childhood barbecues my dad would make.  Sometimes you can’t beat charcoal flavor?
Results.Title: Childhood Memories

Results.ReviewText: Great quality and build. Very happy with this grill. Can't go wrong with a Weber.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I won't buy anything but Weber grills. 40 years of loyalty.
Results.Title: Always buy Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Simple yet delicious . This grill is great for the beginner or the pro. It doesn’t have all the bells and whistles , but if you’re grilling and wanted delicious food this is your grill .

Results.ReviewText: Simplicity at its best. Using the chimney (sold separately), starting the fire, pouring the coals, and grilling burgers has never been so easy.  Then emptying the ash is quick and also easy.

Results.ReviewText: Love the ease of charcoal clean up. Timeless design that works beautifully.

I wanted a good, sturdy, simple charcoal grill....and this one is perfect.
Good size, reasonably priced, easy to assemble, and I know it will last many years.

We are happy to help provide further information on this. Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I can't seem to get it to heat up. I have changed out the charcoal, I have tried different vent settings, I have tried different quantities of charcoal and where it is placed in the grill. It just never seems to reach a searing temperature. It took 10 to 15 minutes for charcoal to get started and then another 1 hour and 20 minutes to cook 6 chicken thighs the other evening. I have friends with the bigger Webber and they have no problem. I just need to figure out if it's the grill or me.
Results.Title: Grill Never Gets Hot Enough

Results.ReviewText: Nothing beats a good ole Weber Grill. This was a replacement for basically the same grill that we had for 40 plus years.
Results.Title: Old Faithful

741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
